terms.label: Linear velocity tracking
terms.blurb: Follow the commanded forward velocity. The task itself.

terms.label: Torque penalty
terms.blurb: Discourage large joint torques; saves the actuators.

terms.label: Joint acceleration penalty
terms.blurb: Smooths the motion by pricing jerky joints.

terms.label: Action-rate penalty
terms.blurb: Penalizes step-to-step action changes; suppresses chatter.

terms.label: Joint limit penalty
terms.blurb: Keeps joints off their mechanical stops.

terms.label: Collision penalty
terms.blurb: Penalizes contact on bodies that should never touch.

terms.label: Base height
terms.blurb: Holds the torso near a target height.

terms.label: Orientation penalty
terms.blurb: Penalizes roll and pitch away from level.

terms.label: Foot air time
terms.blurb: Illustrative air-time contribution; not the reference first-contact calculation.

terms.label: Foot stumble penalty
terms.blurb: Penalizes feet catching vertical surfaces mid-stride.

terms.label: Termination penalty
terms.blurb: Falling over ends the episode at a cost.

balanced.name: balanced trot
balanced.description: This toy selects a balanced trot when none of its three failure-category rules fires. The motion is drawn from a fixed gait pattern, not an optimized policy.

frozen.name: freeze attractor
frozen.description: This toy selects freeze when the torque weight crosses its fixed absolute and relative thresholds. The stationary preview is a teaching choice, not a trained optimum.

prancing.name: prance attractor
prancing.description: This toy selects prance when the air-time weight crosses its fixed absolute and relative thresholds. The bouncing preview is not the reference first-contact reward or a trained policy.

chatter.name: chatter attractor
chatter.description: This toy selects chatter when the action-rate weight is at or below its fixed threshold. The drawn vibration is not a measured control frequency or an actuator-damage prediction.

values.authoredCaseBasis: Fixed illustrative test inputs from model defaults and bounds, not measured or learned results.
